title: The Locked Drawer (synthetic test fixture)
source_language: English — synthetic test fixture, not a real production input. Real runs supply rights-cleared Hindi/Japanese/Korean/Arabic/Russian/Spanish source lyrics per docs/PRODUCTION_WORKFLOW.md.
context_note: A song about a woman who keeps a former partner's letters in a locked drawer and reopens the wound of losing him nightly, until the final section, where she leaves the drawer open for the first time.

sections.name: verse_1
sections.source_text:
She keeps his letters in a locked drawer,
the way you keep a wound you won't let heal.

sections.name: pre_chorus
sections.source_text:
Every night she turns the key,
just to feel it hurt again.

sections.name: chorus
sections.source_text:
And still she keeps the drawer locked tight —
not because she's forgotten,
but because she's afraid of what forgetting means.

sections.name: bridge
sections.source_text:
Tonight, for the first time,
she leaves it open.
